assets.title: Golf Club
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: finished landscape website promotional card, approximately 5:4 aspect ratio.
Create a new Hula Hula Golf Club illustration in the same visual family as the supplied Hula Hula Resort style references: slim warm ivory outer border, softly rounded inner artwork corners, premium hand-painted gouache with textured screenprint details, rich tropical leafy greens, turquoise, golden pineapple yellow, small coral-red hibiscus accents. Charming sophisticated tropical holiday illustration, not photorealistic, not a 3D render. Preserve the reference family’s golden pineapple mascot: friendly black sunglasses, small curved smiling mouth, natural green pineapple crown, chunky rounded golden pineapple body with elegant diamond skin texture and simple golden mitten-like hands. Adapt the mascot into a relaxed golfer using a small dark green visor below the pineapple leaves and tasteful golf equipment. Preserve excellent thumbnail readability and a clear hierarchy.
Typography: very large bold expressive substantial serif letters, straight and crisp, generous upper ivory/cream sky negative space, title fully inside safe margins. Brand line "Hula Hula" in fresh leafy green; theme below in deep teal unless otherwise specified. The brand words must be spelled exactly Hula Hula. No official logo redraw. No extra text, prices, discounts, schedules, real-world course claims, watermark or outside mockup. Only the exact requested title words. Do not repeat any title words from the references unless explicitly requested below. Tropical golf landscapes are imaginative brand concepts, not documentary representations of a real property.
Primary request: the main Hula Hula Golf Club brand card. Exact text only, two prominent lines: "Hula Hula" and "Golf Club". Keep the title across the upper third, huge and legible.
Scene: a beautiful inviting tropical golf green in the lower two-thirds, manicured rolling fairway, white flagstick with a small coral triangular golf flag on the right, a visible putting cup and small white golf ball nearby. The cheerful pineapple golfer stands at the left foreground holding a realistically shaped golf iron beside a cream-and-forest-green golf bag. A tiny charming golf cart on a curving path far behind, palms and red hibiscus framing edges, turquoise lagoon and stylized distant Krabi limestone cliffs on the horizon, warm fresh morning sunshine and subtle golden sky. Main focal points are pineapple golfer and beautiful green; avoid a pool. Make this feel like a natural extension of the original resort cards with a fresh golf story. One finished flat landscape illustration, opaque background.

assets.title: Pineapple golfer
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable isolated transparent brand mascot.
Generate ONE full-body Hula Hula pineapple golfer mascot, using the supplied main Golf Club card as the PRIMARY IDENTITY REFERENCE and the resort references only as supporting style references. Match exactly the friendly golden pineapple character: chunky rounded golden diamond-textured pineapple body, black sunglasses with subtle warm reflection, small curved smiling mouth, lush natural green pineapple crown, dark forest green golf visor worn below leaves, simple golden mitten-like hands and short rounded feet. Preserve premium hand-painted gouache / textured screenprint illustration and the same colour palette, illustration rendering and proportions as the main Golf Club card. The mascot stands in a charming relaxed pose facing slightly right, one hand holding one realistically proportioned golf iron with a single thin silver shaft and clear clubhead resting beside its foot, other hand giving a friendly casual thumbs-up. A single small white golf ball next to the clubhead. Character fully visible including leaves, visor, both hands, feet and golf club, generous clear margins, occupying most of a square composition. GENUINE TRANSPARENT background with alpha: no scenery, no square or circle backing, no cream panel, no checkerboard drawn into image, no text, no lettering, no logos, no price, no watermark. Grounding only minimal subtle natural shadow if needed, preserve transparency everywhere else.
